title: AppleNotestoX
description: Local-first macOS pipeline that turns Apple Notes into a durable, reviewable knowledge wiki.
highlights: Built a macOS app that exports between Apple Notes, Markdown and Notion, tagging each export with the original note's unique ID and date.

Bundled a study tool with spaced-repetition flashcards and on-device video transcription with Apple Speech for exports and flashcard notes, plus an AI assistant (Groq/Llama) that groups related notes, merges them and flags duplicates for cleanup.

title: X Bookmark Injector
description: A Chromium extension that resurfaces a random saved X bookmark at the top of your For You feed.
highlights: Built a Chromium extension that randomly pulls a saved X bookmark to the top of For You, with Keep, Done and background auto-sync.
Retrieved bookmarks through X's internal GraphQL API from the page, reusing the logged-in session, with a service worker that paginates, schema-validates and caches them in chrome.storage.
